Tactically, the prospective client is establishing a rigid paper trail of notice. The attachments reveal a highly radioactive prospective client entangled in multi-agency federal disputes, including SEC whistleblower retaliation, criminal referrals against named individuals (Herche, McDonald), and DoD licensing issues involving Under Secretary Heidi Shyu. Reviewing these attachments triggers ABA Model Rule 1.18 duties to a prospective client and risks disqualifying the firm from representing the DoD contractors or government entities involved.

Initiate a firm-wide, expedited conflicts check against all named entities, including the Department of Defense, Heidi Shyu, Cody Matthew Herche, Colin McDonald, and the SEC.
